title: Attestation
description: A tamper-evident record that a specific RunResult was stored in a content-addressed blob store. Verification re-fetches the blob by id, recomputes its hash, and asserts it matches content_sha256.

run_id.description: The run_id of the attested RunResult.

scenario_set_hash.description: Copied from the attested RunResult; binds the attestation to the exact scored inputs.

store.description: Which blob store holds the bytes.

blob_id.description: Content-addressed identifier returned by the blob store. For Walrus this is the blobId; for the stub it is a deterministic local id.

content_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the exact canonical RunResult bytes that were stored. The integrity anchor.
